metadata.description: Five small Claude Code mods that enforce the ground rules an agent keeps breaking: stay in the project directory, stop what you started, check what you cite, wait instead of polling, save work before erasing it.

plugins.name: stay-put
plugins.description: Bounces `cd dir && …` before it runs and gives Claude the one-command form.

plugins.name: lights-out
plugins.description: Shows the background tasks this session left running and how much memory is free. Stops only what it started.

plugins.name: spotcheck
plugins.description: Checks the files, line numbers and symbols a subagent cites before Claude repeats the report.

plugins.name: wake-me
plugins.description: Claude ends its turn instead of polling. You watch the progress bar, and the mod wakes Claude when the file is ready.

plugins.name: save-point
plugins.description: Saves uncommitted work a moment before a command erases it. /save-point brings it back.
